summary: Every transcript and the note index render through one element renderer, and the blocks that carry them through one injector.
reason: Internal: prompt assembly only, no user-visible behaviour change intended. #220 shipped ContextBlock/assemble/render_messages and wired one prompt builder of six; #292 finishes all three axes — every transcript through one element renderer (6/6), every model-facing block through one injector (9/9 modules converted, HAND_WRITTEN is empty), and the note index through one renderer for all three consumers. Prompt BYTES change for six graded prompts. TWO blocks newly carry untrusted="true": <tag_message> (#239 — a change to what she is told on the message she was asked to answer) and <open_notes> (which took ContextBlock's default when the proactive pass was converted; master's hand-built tag had no marker). <open_notes> was not named in any commit message when it changed, which is why it is named here — a change to what she is told on the message she was asked to answer, which the participation and routing suites settle. A green pytest run is not that measurement. Six defects fixed on the way, every one found by audit or by a gate rather than by the suite: a member's newline could imitate the note curator's own prose fields; the debrief legend told the model to read a delivery token only a member could type; an empty-after-collapse attribute rendered from=""; a safety test was passing by counting the forgery it was written to catch; three forgery tests used a payload that had become inert, so they passed with escape() deleted; and an indent helper silently rewrote member content.
